titles.title: REACH Our Tribes Act
REACH Our Tribes Act
Rural Economic-development Assistance and Consultation to Help Our Tribes Act

A bill to amend the Federal Crop Insurance Reform and Department of Agriculture Reorganization Act of 1994 to establish a budgetary Tribal Government consultation process at the Department of Agriculture, and for other purposes.

action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Agriculture, Nutrition, and Forestry.
